age.evidence: Female Swiss mice of 6 weeks old were used in this study.

sex.evidence: Female Swiss mice of 6 weeks old were used in this study.

dosing.doses_raw: AF II (6 mg/kg, s.c.); composed of 90% DMT (6 mg = 5.4 mg of DMT)
dosing.evidence: the animals were divided into three groups: 0.9% NaCl (vehicle group, s.c.), AF II (6 mg/kg, s.c.), and diazepam - DZp (5 mg/kg, s.c.). ... the AF II used in this work is composed of 90% DMT (6 mg = 5.4 mg of DMT).

handling.evidence: not reported (experimental section supplied as online-only material; not available in main text)

assays.assay_description: Light/dark box test assessing anxiety based on aversion to illuminated areas; measured number of crossings and time spent in the light compartment. AF II 6 mg/kg s.c. vs vehicle vs diazepam.

setup_habituation.evidence: not reported in main text (experimental supplied online only)

setup_restrain.evidence: the light-dark box test is based on the aversion to illuminated areas and the spontaneous exploratory behaviour of rodents in a new environment

food_restriction.evidence: standard light-dark box apparatus; food not in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: standard light-dark box apparatus; water not in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: timing of test relative to dose not stated in main text

sample_size.evidence: the animals were divided into three groups; n per group not reported in main text

outcomes.summary: AF II (6 mg/kg, s.c.) significantly increased the number of crossings (26.6 ± 4.08 vs 17.8 ± 2.8 vehicle) and time spent in the light compartment (165.0 ± 7.7 s vs 98.6 ± 7.0 s vehicle), indicating an anxiolytic-like effect in female Swiss mice.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.001 for number of crossings; p < 0.001 for time in light compartment
outcomes.evidence: AF II, at a dose of 6 mg/kg, showed a significant anxiolytic-like effect (*** p < 0.001) on the number of crossings (26.6 ± 4.08) when compared to the vehicle group (17.8 ± 2.8). ... AF II again showed a significant effect (*** p < 0.001) in the animals time spent in the light compartment (165.0 ± 7.7 s) when compared to the vehicle group (98.6 ± 7.0 s).

assays.assay_description: Elevated plus maze assessing anxiety based on aversion to open space and altitude; measured time spent in open arms and closed arms. AF II 6 mg/kg s.c. vs vehicle vs diazepam.

setup_restrain.evidence: EPM is a free-movement apparatus; no restraint mentioned

food_restriction.evidence: standard EPM apparatus; food not in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: standard EPM apparatus; water not in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: timing of test relative to dose not stated in main text

sample_size.evidence: n per group not reported in main text

outcomes.summary: AF II (6 mg/kg, s.c.) significantly decreased time spent in closed arms (59.6 ± 12.3 s vs 213.0 ± 18.8 s vehicle) and increased time in open arms (120.3 ± 11.7 s vs 36.4 ± 7.4 s vehicle), indicating an anxiolytic-like effect.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.001 for time in closed arms; p < 0.001 for time in open arms
outcomes.evidence: the group treated with AF II spent significantly (*** p < 0.001) less time in the closed arms (59.6 ± 12.3 s) and more time in the open arms (120.3 ± 11.7s) when compared to the vehicle group (213.0 ± 18.8 s and 36.4 ± 7.4 s, respectively).

B1_num_measures.evidence: time in closed arms and time in open arms

B4_ethological.evidence: time in arms is a spatial measure, not an ethological behaviour

B6_cognitive.evidence: innate anxiety test based on aversion

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of apparatus design, not an enclosed refuge per rubric definition

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform per rubric

D2_session_duration.evidence: duration not explicitly reported in main text; standard EPM tests are typically 5 min

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on two assays (Light/Dark Box and EPM); consolidated directly.
Compound listed as DMT (the active psychedelic in AF II, which is 90% DMT). Doses_mg_per_kg set to 5.4 (the DMT-equivalent dose) consistent with two of three candidates; raw text preserved.

Experimental details (Section 3) are stated as 'Supplied as online-only material' — hence handling, group_housing, light cycle, session durations, sample sizes, and timing are scored not_reported with low confidence rather than inferred.
EPM E2_shelter scored 0 and E6_spatial scored 0 per explicit rubric instruction that EPM closed arms do not count as shelter and EPM is not multiple zones.
